newsitem.title: USA: NASDAQ STOCKS RALLY TO STRONG CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: NASDAQ STOCKS RALLY TO STRONG CLOSE.

text.p: A powerhouse preformance in the high techs, in particular industry giant Microsoft Corp, propelled the Nasdaq Composite to a sharply higher close on Thursday.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 11.86 points, or 1.03 percent, at 1165.81 while advances led declining issues by 2220 to 1797 on volume of about 550 million shares.
Microsoft was up 3-1/2 at 128-5/8 after outlining an aggressive rollout of several new Internet-based products and services, speeding its efforts to grab a lion's share of this emerging market.

Other stocks followed suit. U.S. Robotics Corp soared 4-7/8 to 61-3/4 and topped the over-the-counter most active list. the stock jumped to its highest level in over a month as expectations grew that the company would have a faster modem on the market by the end of the year.
Other high techs coasting comfortably higher in active trading included Cisco Systems Inc , up 4-7/8 at 61-3/4, Sun Microsystems Inc , up 15/16 at 55-12/16 and Intel Corp, up 3/8 at 85-3/8.
